Hi all,

Reviewed Emily's calc and current band mapping. Recommendation below (keeps us competitive in Madrid while limiting premium spending):

Recommendation (applies to external offers for hires hired remote-in-region):
- EU (Madrid, Amsterdam, Berlin): +9% uplift to base relative to our US-equivalent mapped band. Rationale: local tech market pricing and social taxes. For Carlos specifically: EU uplift moves offer from €88k to ~€96k which matches candidate expectation.
- UK (London): +12% uplift (separate payroll/tax regime).
- APAC (India, SG): apply location-specific midpoints — India: -8% to US-equivalent, SG: +3% (we keep a regional multiplier table).

Structure for offer: keep base in local currency with Redwood band label (Senior SWE, Band S3). Include a 6-month performance review with eligibility for a locality adjustment/cost-of-living re-eval if market moves.

Approvals needed: Finance confirmation on headcount/budget and one leadership sign-off for any uplift >10% (we are under that for Madrid).

Attachments referenced: offer-calculation-2026Q3.xlsx (cells: COMP_MAYA_EU), offer-template-US-EU-APAC.docx

Maya Srinivasan
Compensation Manager, Redwood Inference
